text: ExPerT was selected as an SAC Highlight at ACL 2026 — Top 2%!
Presented ExPerT at ACL 2026 in San Diego!
Our paper ExPerT was accepted to ACL 2026 (Main, Long) — Oral Presentation, Top 4%! See you in San Diego!
Teaching assistant for Mobile Computing (CSE465) and On-Device AI for Smart Manufacturing (NOV A508) at UNIST.
Served as a reviewer for ACM CHI 2026 and ACM CHI 2026 Posters.
Filed a Korean patent application with Taesik Gong: LLM Response Personalization Based on User Expertise Utilizing Query-Level Semantic and Behavioral Cues (November 19; No. 10-2025-0175678).

Joined the IITP-funded project Robust Vision-Language-Action Integrated On-Device AI for Innovations of Manufacturing Industry as a participating researcher (AI Star Fellowship; PI: Prof. Jaeyoung Sim).
Teaching assistant for Computer Networks (CSE351) at UNIST.
We presented GazeHandSync at ETRA 2025! I also served as a student volunteer at ACM ETRA 2025.
Joined UNIST AIGS for graduate studies in Artificial Intelligence, advised by Prof. Taesik Gong.
Joined the NRF-funded project Personalized On-Device Multi-modal Small Language Model for Memory Assistance as a participating researcher (PI: Prof. Taesik Gong). Research outcome: ExPerT.

Joined the IITP-funded project Developing Multimodal Generative AI Talent for Industrial Convergence as a participating researcher (PI: Prof. Jaeyoung Sim). Outcomes include ExPerT and Conversational Traffic Agent Using LLMs with Traffic Information and User Context.
My first first-authored paper, GazeHandSync, was accepted to ETRA '25 — see you in Tokyo!
Graduated with a B.S. in Electrical Engineering & Design (dual major) from UNIST.
Started an undergraduate research internship on human-centered AI at the Ubiquitous Artificial Intelligence Lab, UNIST, supervised by Prof. Taesik Gong (December 2024 – February 2025).
Presented our workshop paper on gaze-pinch interaction at UbiComp / ISWC 2024.
Began an undergraduate research internship on gaze-based VR interaction at the Wearable Interactive Technology Lab, KAIST, supervised by Prof. Ian Oakley (January – November 2024).
Joined the NRF-funded project Multimodal Interaction for Augmented Reality as a participating researcher (PI: Prof. Ian Oakley; January 2024 – February 2025). Research outcome: GazeHandSync.
Won a Red Dot Award for BBB: Revolutionising Cross-Language Communication Services.
Started an undergraduate research internship on human-centered AI applications at the Expressive Computing Lab, UNIST, supervised by Prof. Kyungho Lee (August 2022 – June 2023).
Presented the interactive media-art Wishes at DSUS 2022.
